subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should session workspace listings expose existence, size, or mtime for transcript-mentioned files or directories outside the fs-safe workspace boundary?
rationale: The remaining fix path crosses a security-sensitive file metadata boundary, and automation cannot choose whether external transcript paths should be hidden, filtered, or deliberately exposed.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths stay hidden or neutral, and the UI/backend fix must solve false Missing semantics without raw host filesystem stat calls.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The Gateway may report external existence metadata, but only with explicit maintainer acceptance, tests, and documented boundary semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths stay hidden or neutral, and the UI/backend fix must solve false Missing semantics without raw host filesystem stat calls.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace browsing and file-preview commits make this the strongest available owner for the fs-safe metadata boundary choice.
